ModMetaData.name: Prepatcher (1.7)
ModMetaData.author: Zetrith, 1.7 port by Ren
ModMetaData.description:
Prepatcher updated for 1.7. All Zetrith's work, I just fixed the parts the new engine broke.
Unsubscribe the original first, they share a mod id.
Harmony isn't bundled anymore. Get the Harmony mod and load it above this.
If a mod has a patch Harmony 3 won't accept, that patch gets skipped and logged instead of breaking the whole mod.
If Zetrith wants this taken down or releases his own 1.7 version, let me know and I'll remove it.
